question: Which of the following oilfields is NOT located in Gujarat?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naharkatiya**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Naharkatiya** is an oilfield located in the state of Assam, not Gujarat.
 
• The other oilfields mentioned in the options, namely **Kosamba, Nawagam, and Kalol**, are all located in Gujarat.
 
• Gujarat is one of the leading states in India in terms of oil production, with several significant oilfields contributing to its output.
 
• Assam is another major oil-producing state in India, with Naharkatiya being one of its prominent oilfields.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India has a diverse geography with oilfields spread across various states, contributing significantly to the country's energy needs.
 
• The discovery of oil in Assam dates back to the early 20th century, making it one of the oldest oil-producing regions in India.
 
• Gujarat's oilfields have been pivotal in enhancing India's domestic oil production, reducing the dependency on imports.
 
• Oil exploration and production are critical components of India's energy strategy, aiming to achieve energy security and sustainability.
